content: Cloudinary delivery types: upload (public CDN), private (original signed; derived public unless strict transformations), authenticated (original and derived require signed URL). Docs: 'You can't create on-the-fly transformations for authenticated assets... only access derived assets generated ahead of time during upload or update using eager transformations.' Signed delivery URLs do not expire; token/cookie-based expiring access is Advanced plan+. Source cloudinary.com/documentation/control_access_to_media.
